gaps: The plan cannot verify that no bid was saved because surrogate_bid does not provide bidUuid and no available operation lists or searches bids.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer enters a bid on a vendor's behalf (surrogate bid) with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_ref_…”, with 1 attachments.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “failed to add remark”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
